content.text:
Scope: not applicable. You named one prior session, 7f3a, and recall doesn't rebuild a single named session.

To pick it up, run `claude --resume 7f3a` from `/private/var/folders/h_/h42hf5_179g1grz4t4yx62w40000gn/T/w-11TrHX/billing-service`. Sessions are stored per project, so it has to be that directory. If the ID doesn't match, `claude --resume` with no argument opens a picker.

If you'd rather have a brief of where the billing-service work stands (open PRs, kern ledgers, worktrees), say so. I'd need a window and a topic, and I'd default to the last 7 days.
